dry_run_budget_status.authorization_note: Meeting numerical dry-run caps does NOT authorize data extraction or imply scientific equivalence.

task_definition.historical_unit_of_observation: Fixed 5-minute sliding telemetry windows of individual container tasks (task_id, window_index)
task_definition.observation_shift: Shift from continuous dynamic container time series to discrete static job submission metadata
task_definition.lead_time_definition: delta_t = t_terminal - t_submit (Entire job execution lifetime, ranging from seconds to weeks)
task_definition.telemetry_features_available: NONE. collection_events contains zero CPU, memory, CPI, page cache, or time-series usage metrics.

leakage_table.leakage_risk: High (Monotonically increasing ID; leaks global cluster epoch/time).
High (Workflow group ID; causes co-occurrence leakage between train and val if parent appears in both).
Critical (Categorical user ID; models memorize users with buggy code rather than learning system signals).
Critical (Job name string; periodic recurring cron jobs share identical names, creating direct target memorization).
Fatal (Future target timestamp; strictly excluded from features).
Fatal (Future target label; strictly excluded from features).
Fatal (Future target string; strictly excluded from features).

temporal_leakage_audit.leakage_summary: If restricted to admission-time fields, no future target leakage occurs. However, severe categorical memorization leakage exists for 'user' and 'collection_name' across repeated periodic jobs.

label_feasibility.failure_target: FAIL (event code 5): Abnormal job termination where one or more non-retryable tasks failed.
label_feasibility.normal_anchor: FINISH (event code 6): Clean successful completion of all collection tasks.
competing_risks: KILL (event code 7): Explicit user or parent workflow cancellation.
EVICT (event code 4): Collection-level preemption by scheduler.
label_feasibility.censoring_and_incomplete_jobs: Long-running service collections (daemons, databases, web serving tiers) run indefinitely and never log FINISH or FAIL within Day 1. Truncating at Day 1 results in right-censoring for all service jobs, severely biasing the sample toward short batch jobs.
label_feasibility.applicability_of_original_lead_time_hori: INAPPLICABLE. The original 5-minute critical (Class 2) and 10-25 minute warning (Class 1) horizons are defined relative to sliding 5-minute telemetry windows during active execution. At job submission, the job has not even been scheduled or assigned to machines. A job may wait in queue for 15 minutes and execute for 4 hours. A 5-minute failure proximity label cannot be evaluated at admission time without continuous runtime telemetry.

validation_feasibility.group_split_feasible: Feasible by grouping on parent_collection_id or user.

Episode_Recall_ge_70.reason: Episodes were defined as sequences of failure-bound 5-minute telemetry windows. Candidate D has no telemetry windows.

Genuine_Critical_Recall_ge_50.reason: Critical windows were defined as 0-5 minutes prior to container failure. Candidate D has no critical window observations.

Pure_Normal_Entity_FAR_le_10.reason: Can be adapted as False Alarm Rate on pure-normal parent collections.

Normal_Window_FPR_le_5.reason: Normal windows were sliding 5-minute non-failure intervals. Candidate D has no window structure.

validation_feasibility.comparability_summary: Candidate D cannot evaluate three of the four governing Phase 7B operational gates. Model outputs cannot be compared against Phase 7B-7U results.

justification: 1. Modality Mismatch: Phase 7S-7U models (S0, S2, Hybrid, Fuzzy) strictly require input tensors of shape (batch, seq_len=12, features=6) containing standardized CPU and memory telemetry. Candidate D contains zero telemetry.
2. Model Incompatibility: Frozen neural and fuzzy models developed in Phases 7N-7U cannot be tested or evaluated on Candidate D without retraining an entirely different tabular architecture.

3. Problem Re-framing: Candidate D changes the core scientific question from 'Can continuous runtime container telemetry predict imminent software crashes?' to 'Can static submission metadata predict job failure proneness at admission?'.
